newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Bank stock supports Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Bank stock supports Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, Semdex, edged 0.49 points to 377.68 on Monday after a share price rise in blue chip Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB), brokers said.
Turnover leaped to 8.14 million rupees on 421,868 shares from 7.45 million rupees on 297,615 shares last Friday.
The MCB gained 1.50 rupee to 87.50 rupees on 1,026 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) rose 10 cents to 11.50 rupee s on 263,750 shares.
Sugar based Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) lost 10 cents to 39.00 rupees on 13,539 shares and Harel Freres was stable at 57.00 rupees on 1,180 shares.

In the commercial sector, conglomerate Rogers was 4.00 rupees lower to 93.00 rupees on 1,308 shares, Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) climbed 20 cents to 15.80 rupees on 9,000 shares and Happy World Foods (HWF) gained 40 cents to 15.90 rupees on 3,400 shares.

In the tourism sector, Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) rose 80 cents to 48.00 rupees on 8,000 shares, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) was unchanged to 37.00 rupees on 64,930 shares and Sun Resorts climbed 50 cents to 49.10 rupees, but was unquoted.
Air Mauritius was stable at 39.00 rupees on 500 shares.
